questions.stem: Why is maintaining biodiversity important for ecosystems?

options.text: It prevents all species from evolving
It makes ecosystems look more attractive to tourists
It makes ecosystems more stable and resilient to changes
It ensures all organisms are the same size

questions.explanation: High biodiversity makes ecosystems more stable and resilient. With many different species, if one is affected by disease or environmental change, others can fill its role. Low biodiversity makes ecosystems fragile and more vulnerable to collapse.
